summary: The v21 signature-reference writer now needs its own activation flag as well as a store fenced at version 21 or later, so a later format's version fence no longer switches it on.

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger or storage version change. A new meta key, claim_signature_reference_writer, is read and never written by this release.

rules.detail: Signature authority, verdicts and reference reading are unchanged. The default writer stays at version 20 text. user_version is a reader fence only; each writer turns on through its own meta flag.

compatibility.detail: No wire, digest or capability change. Peers of any version are unaffected. No released build has written version 21, so no production store loses an active writer.

recovery.detail: Rolling back to the previous release is supported; it reads the same stores and never writes the flag.
